newsitem.title: UK: Charles and Diana both attend son's carol service.
newsitem.headline: Charles and Diana both attend son's carol service.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles and his ex-wife Princess Diana both on Sunday attended a carol service at their son's exclusive school, the first time they have appeared at the same function since their divorce last August.
They arrived separately at Eton College, west of London, where their 14-year-old eldest son Prince William is a student.

The Mail on Sunday newspaper had earlier reported that Charles had tried to thaw their frosty relationship by asking his mother Queen Elizabeth to invite Diana to a lunch at Buckingham Palace on December 18.
A palace spokesman declined to comment on the report -- or on another newspaper report that the queen's youngest son Prince Edward was about to break up with his girlfriend Sophie Rhys-Jones.
